title: Prospective Breast Cancer Biobanking
brief_summary: Prospective Breast Cancer Biobanking study (PBCB) will apply advanced monitoring in liquid biopsies of early staged breast cancer ration in order to facilitate A. Early detection of systemic relapses B.Improve adherence and drug monitoring av tamoxifen treatment C. Tumour microenvironment in breast cancer - adipose stromal immune infiltration and interaction with tumour at the growth zone D.Monitor side effects, QoL, depression, fatigue and work life participation
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Early stage Breast Cancer
* DCIS gr III

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not able to read Norwegian
* Not able to communicate in Norwegian
* Previously diagnosed with cancer
* Dementia
study_population: Women in the catchment area of Haukeland University Hospital (Bergen) and Stavanger University Hospital (Stavanger) in Western Norway
